title: Smoke story: create the acceptance canary (natural-route re-run, M4R)
summary: Create one three-line file with frozen bytes in a disposable target repository and report completion. Deterministic gate (tests/gate.sh v3) checks the bytes and that nothing else changed. Trivial, fully specified, no judgment calls; the point of the run is the routing and launch chain, not the content. The worker on the natural standard-band route has no shell and only Read/Glob/Grep/Write.
